movistarVm05.title: MOVISTAR VM 05
cues: Movistar
The requested line is not answering; it is currently unavailable,
Movistar
You may leave a voice message after the tone:
Frenzy
Let's see, I was on my way to the party at the building,
Frenzy
but I might have gone to the wrong floor. No idea,
Frenzy
but when I first came in, some lights were dimly on,
Frenzy
and I could hear music in the background, so I walked
Frenzy
toward where the party was supposed to be,
Frenzy
but something was really weird: there wasn't any door. It was all dark,
Frenzy
so I felt along the wall to see if I could find a doorknob or something,
Frenzy
but my hand—my hand went right through the wall, and before I could react,
Frenzy
my body went through too. I entered a really strange place; it should've been the stairwell,
Frenzy
but everything, everything has a green light. A sickly green light,
Frenzy
the music was still playing in the distance, so I followed it out of curiosity,
Frenzy
eventually I found a strange door, and when I crossed it, I ended up in this room,
Frenzy
it's full of cassettes scattered on the floor, and a tape recorder is playing something,
Frenzy
it's hard to tell what song it is, but I'll look it up later.
Frenzy
Listen, just now, as I was getting closer,
Frenzy
I think there was a voice in the background, so I decided to get out of here,
Frenzy
I'll try to cross back outside, but this is way too strange,
Frenzy
I just want you to know that if I don't get back to you
Frenzy
it's because something caught up with me,
Movistar
Your message has been saved. Thank you for using the service…

cues: Vella
It's so cold in here... God, please let Frenzy be okay... please let him be okay...
Vella
Psyco, please read this. Frenzy is in shock at Central Hospital.
Vella
Early this morning, after the party he never managed to reach, some guards found him near the building.
Vella
He's cold and staring blankly. His heart is beating as usual, but he's... in shock!
Vella
He's not injured, just... HE'S... freezing. I really don't understand.
EFFECT
Digital interference; the word “understand” repeats and distorts.
Vella
It's as if something got inside him, or as if something is missing inside.
Vella
Honestly, when they first told me, I thought it was a joke... I wish it had been.
Vella
I had to go to his apartment and take the keys from under his doormat to look for his university papers; I only found his study materials and an ID.
Vella
I don't know what to do! I can't BUSCA... I can't deal with this alone.
Vella
All I have is this voicemail he sent me in the early hours... I'll attach it.
Vella
Please don't panic, okay? He's your coworker, our friend... you know he's not crazy.
Vella
I think someone scared him or did something serious to him... Or maybe he shouldn't have gone into that paranormal place.
EFFECT
Total cut. Heavy interference; Frenzy's voice repeats “luces verdes... luces verdes...”
Vella
Please don't reply to this email.
Vella
If CUERPOS... if you're going to help me, go straight to Central Hospital. I'll wait for you there.
EFFECT
Vella sends the email, shuts down the computer, and leaves the apartment.
Vella
Please, Frenzy... you have to be okay...
